detail.longDescription: SEO was built for human clicks. GEO was built for AI summaries. Agentic AEO is built for AI action. If autonomous AI agents can't parse your DOM, verify your entities, or act on your pricing and CTAs, they'll skip your site completely. Your new checklist: → Front-load direct answers in the first 50 words → Use clean HTML tables & Schema.org markup → Audit your llms.txt & robots.txt permissions Don't just chase clicks—become machine-ready. # AEO # GEO # SEO # AIAgents # TechSEO
